lead.title: Forsyth Daily Brief is coming soon
lead.summary: The first edition will combine public meetings, school notices, safety information, events, and local reporting for Forsyth County.

facts.meetings: County and school-board calendars will highlight what residents can attend or follow next.

items.title: Forsyth Daily Brief is being built from public sources
